verdicts.reason: A keeps the attribution directly under the quote. But the attribution is indented from the quote's left edge and runs almost to the right edge of the canvas, there is a dead gap between the quote mark and the quote, and the logo row is crammed into the circle under the can. B makes the same indent and edge mistakes and also leaves a large empty gap between the quote and its attribution, so the credit looks like a stray fragment. Both share the same weak bottom, with an unreadable SOLSTICE label and a cramped logo.
